body.x: A crime scene is photographed and measured, then cleared and gone. Investigators who want to revisit it later depend on whatever was captured at the time.
MeTown Inc. was named a 2027 Honoree in XR & Spatial Computing at the CES 2027 Innovation Awards for EVOVA Forensics, a conversational crime-scene AI.

EVOVA Forensics is on-premises software that reconstructs crime scenes as hyper-realistic 3D environments from smartphone or camera footage, then analyzes them through evidence-backed conversational AI. A proof of concept with the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and the Graduate School of Film and Communication of Hongik University is underway.

Existing 3D systems preserve geometry, while investigators need separate tools and expertise to measure, interpret and compare scenes. With EVOVA Forensics, they can ask, "How far is the door from the window?" "What appears out of place?" "Are there similar cases in our past scene data?" AI responses include source images, highlighted 3D regions and quantitative results.

It can surface stains, scratches or displaced objects that conventional methods may overlook, and when no supporting evidence is found, it reports that clearly. The engine can extend to fire and disaster investigation, insurance loss assessment and facility safety, creating reusable spatial intelligence for safer communities.

The CES Innovation Awards program, an annual competition honoring outstanding design and engineering in consumer technology products, recognizes all recipients as Honorees at two levels. The Honoree level covers products that score above the scoring threshold in each category, while Best of Innovation goes to the highest-scoring Honorees. A panel of industry expert judges and global media scores each product on engineering and functionality, aesthetic and design, and what makes it unique and innovative.

AVING NEWS, a global media company with 21 years of experience covering CES, operates AVING CES Newsroom (avingces.news), a dedicated platform for delivering the latest innovations to global audiences. Publishing more than 1,000 articles and conducting hundreds of on-site video interviews annually, AVING NEWS has helped Korean startups gain international visibility and expand their global reach. At CES 2027, AVING NEWS will operate the AVING TECH TALK broadcast zone at the Venetian Expo (Hall A, Booth 50271), providing on-site coverage and interviews that spotlight Korean companies and their latest innovations.
